newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bank of E.Asia to set HK$ FRCD - bankers.
newsitem.headline: Bank of E.Asia to set HK$ FRCD - bankers.

text.p: Bank of East Asia has verbally mandated Societe Generale Asia and UBS Hong Kong to arrange a floating rate certificate of deposit issue, bankers said Monday.
They said the issue size is expected to be at least HK$2.5 billion with an effective tenor of three years.
The issue is likely to be priced at par to float at 30 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return is expected to be around 37 basis points, bankers noted.
The issuer is expected to apply to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to accept the issue as eligible for use at the HKMA's Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF), or discount window.
Bank of East Asia is rated A3 by Moody's Investors Service.
